newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks fall sharply in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks fall sharply in late trade.

text.p: Jakarta stocks fell 1.02 percent to 712.32 points in late trade on Tuesday on continued profit- taking particularly in blue chip stocks, brokers said.
"In the mid-afternoon, sellers particularly appeared on tobacco stocks such as Sampoerna and Gudang Garam," a broker with a Hong Kong-based firm said.
She said the selling surfaced after European investors came into the market and added blue-chips were the worst-affected.
Ealier, brokers had said the falls were due to a technical correction after the index closed at a record high on Monday.
